items.evidence: play --ticks 10 --settings s0: {"tick":10,"screen":"title",...} with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts all present.
--frame play.png/title_fr.png/settings_fr.png/shop_fr.png --size 800x480 and the README's own out.png: PNG signature, IHDR 800 x 480.
Fresh folder: texts [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 2:enter -> tick 3 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.
Volume 8 -> right x5 stays 10, left x15 stays 0; language en->es->fr, stops at fr and at en; difficulty normal default, right -> hard (stops), left -> easy (stops).

es and fr texts on title, settings, play, shop (incl. complete lines), paused, won, lost all translated (e.g. 'Boutique','Mains vives : 1/2 - 10 pieces','Vous avez perdu'); string tables have the same keys as en; only the game name and words identical in both languages ('Normal') unchanged.
Run set volume 7, fr, easy in folder s3; next run with s3 starts volume 7, fr, easy (gate 14 on Start). New folder starts volume 8, en, normal.
up held from tick 10: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 at 11, 7 at 20; reaches 12 and stays; down to 0 and stays (0.1 per tick = 6/s).
Held shoot: bolts 5.6 units apart (24 ticks), x +0.2333/tick (14/s); bolt at 19.97 (tick 251) gone next tick.
Wave 1 seed 1: walkers spawn ticks 3,93,183,273,363 (90 ticks) in lanes 4,10,6,2,6, x -0.025/tick (1.5/s), health 2; 5 in all.
Walker y6 at tick 202 health 2->1 and that bolt gone; second hit by 225: walker gone, score 0->10, coins 0->1; bolts at y6 passed walker at y4.

No shots: walker at x 0.05 gone next ticks, gate 10->9, score/coins 0. Hard run: gate 0 at tick ~2200 -> screen lost, texts ['You lost','Score: 0','Best: 0','Enter: title']; from save score 100: 'Score: 100'.
Difficulty easy -> Start gives gate_health 14 ('Porte : 14'); hard -> gate_health 7.

After wave 1's last walker passed (tick 1170): screen shop, enemies [], texts ['Shop','Coins: 0','Next wave: 2','Quick hands: 0/2 - 5 coins','Heavy bolts: 0/1 - 12 coins','Mason: gate 5/10 - 4 coins','Next wave']; guard and state unchanged while up/shoot held.
40 coins: buy 5 -> quick 1 coins 35, buy 10 -> quick 2 coins 25, third Enter -> coins 25 quick 2. Played: quick 1 bolts 4.2 apart (18 ticks), quick 2 2.8 apart (12 ticks).
Heavy bought: coins 25->13, heavy 1; second Enter no change. Wave 2 with heavy: bolts dmg 2, walker in lane 6 destroyed by one bolt (+10, +1 coin); brute took 3 bolts.
Gate 5/10: Mason -> 8 (coins -4), again -> 10 (capped), again at 10/10 coins stay 5. Save with 3 coins, gate 5: Enter on Mason leaves coins 3, gate 5.
Next wave Enter at tick 1206, play from 1207, first walker appears tick 1267 (60 ticks); 7 walkers on field at 2000; texts 'Wave 2 of 8'.
Wave 3 (from save wave 2): 6 walkers then runners at ticks 505,577,649,721 (72 ticks = 1.2 s); runner health 1, x -0.05/tick (3/s); runner killed -> score +15, coins +1.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then brute at tick 649, health 6, x -1/60 per tick; killed by 3 heavy bolts -> +40 points, +3 coins; on Easy gate 6 -> 3 when the brute reached it.
modules/work/data/waves.json lists per wave walkers/runners/brutes/every and kind stats; lib.rs reads it with include_str; README 'How to change a wave' explains.

Continued hand-written wave-7 save (score 100, gate 10), played wave 8 with planned shots: tick 1262 screen won, score 680 = 100 + 380 kill points + 20 x 10 gate; Enter -> title. (Waves 1-7 were not all played in one unbroken run.)
Escape at 100: paused, enemies/bolts identical at 100,150,200; Resume -> x moves on from the same values; Escape then Title -> screen title.
Shop opens -> saved true, kept.save written; next run same folder: texts [name,'Best: 0','Start','Continue','Settings','Quit'].
Folder with Quick x2, Heavy, Mason bought then left: Continue -> shop coins 5, gate 10, quick 2, heavy 1, wave 1, score 30; Next wave -> 'Wave 2 of 8'.

Start with saved run -> saved false, kept.save {}, next run no Continue; lost and won runs -> saved false, kept.save {}; Title from pause in wave 2 -> kept.save still wave 1 shop, next run shows Continue.
Lost with 100 -> kept.best 100, later title 'Best: 100'; won 680 -> 'Best: 680' later; lost with 100 at best 680 -> stays 680; won/lost texts show 'Best: N'.
Two copies of one folder, seed 7, same script, --at 300,600,900: outputs byte-identical. Seeds 1/2/7/12345 give lanes 4,10,6,2,6 / 10,10,6,10,8 / 6,10,6,10,8 / 6,2,10,2,10.

play.png at wave 8: gate (brown, left), guard (blue) at y6, walkers green squares, runners small yellow, brute large red, bolt orange at x4.57 - each where the state says (40 px/unit); HUD 'Score: 150 Coins: 4 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 7'.
French frames: title with Continuer ringed (menu_index 1), settings with 'Langue : Francais' ringed, shop with 'Macon' ringed (menu_index 2); all words in French.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json (same keys); README 'How to add a language' explains copying a table.
README has how to play, keeps in --settings FOLDER/settings.json (volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.save); both README commands run as written printed state and wrote 800x480 out.png.

defects: Escape in the shop opens the Pause menu (the brief says Escape does nothing there); README admits it.

After Enter on a won screen, Enter on Start of the title that comes up does nothing (screen stays title for 200 ticks); after Title from the pause, Down+Enter on Continue also does nothing in the same run. A new run can only begin in a later headless run.
The play HUD ('Score : 0 Pieces : 0 Vague 0 sur 8 Porte : 10') is drawn over the title, settings and shop frames, but is not in texts; on the title it says wave 0.
On the title after giving up from the pause, the report still lists the old run's enemies and bolts.
In title and shop frames a non-chosen button is drawn filled blue (Start, Next wave) besides the focus ring on the chosen one, which makes the marked entry less clear.
The settings screen's dimmed title text shows through behind the settings panel.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
